notes: Sourced from the official Blonder Tongue "HDE-2H/C-QAM Instruction Manual" (Doc No. 651224900B, Rev 2, Aug 2010), which covers both the HDE-2H-QAM (stock #6375, 2xHDMI+2xComponent-to-QAM) and its component-only sibling HDE-2C-QAM (stock #6377, no HDMI/CC inputs) on one shared chassis/manual. Confirmed against the manufacturer's own front/rear panel diagrams and spec tables (Section 2.3). Note this HDE-2H-QAM (single QAM RF output, "F" female) is a different/older product than the similarly-named "HDE-2H/2S-QAM" (stock #6379, adds 2xHD-SDI inputs and 4x independent QAM outputs + GigE) sold via Toner Cable Equipment - do not conflate the two SKUs. No HDMI version (1.4/2.0/etc.) is stated anywhere in the datasheet, so that grade was omitted rather than guessed; the unit only supports up to 1080i/720p and explicitly does not support HDCP. Ethernet grade (eth-100m) inferred from the stated "10/100Base-T" interface spec. EAS Control's screw-terminal block has no exact match in the allowed connector list; "euroblock" was used as the closest analog. The rear ASI In/ASI Out BNC pair is an internal loop (self-looped via an included jumper cable to route the encoder's ASI multiplex into the internal QAM modulator) rather than general-purpose external I/O, though it is physically exposed and usable as such.

ports.name: HDMI 1
ports.note: Unencrypted HDMI only (HDCP not supported); up to 1080i/720p. HDMI version not stated in datasheet.

ports.name: HDMI 2
ports.note: Unencrypted HDMI only (HDCP not supported); up to 1080i/720p. HDMI version not stated in datasheet.

ports.name: CC 1
ports.note: Analog NTSC closed-caption (EIA-608/Line 21) insertion input paired with Input 1 (HDMI 1 or Component In 1).

ports.name: CC 2
ports.note: Analog NTSC closed-caption (EIA-608/Line 21) insertion input paired with Input 2 (HDMI 2 or Component In 2).

ports.name: Component In 1 - Y
ports.note: Analog component video, part of 3xRCA Y/Pb/Pr set.

ports.name: EAS Input - Video
ports.note: Emergency Alert System video feed; substituted onto QAM output when EAS Control is triggered.

ports.name: EAS Control
ports.note: Screw-terminal strip (IN/GROUND), 5-12VDC or dry-contact closure trigger for EAS. Closest listed connector id to the actual pluggable terminal block.

ports.name: ASI Out
ports.note: Front-panel primary usable output: DVB-ASI (EN 50083-9), 270 Mbps multiplexed transport stream; typically feeds an external modulator. Not a video-SDI signal, so no SDI bandwidth grade applies.

ports.name: ASI In
ports.note: Rear panel; feeds the internal ASI-to-QAM modulator, normally looped from the rear ASI Out via the included BNC jumper cable.

ports.name: ASI Out (rear, loop)
ports.note: Rear panel; duplicate of the multiplexed ASI stream, intended to loop into the adjacent ASI In via included jumper cable.

ports.name: QAM RF Out
ports.note: Primary RF output, agile 5.75-864MHz, QAM16/32/64/128/256/512/1024, up to +60dBmV. No standardized bandwidth grade scale applies to F-type/QAM RF.

ports.name: QAM RF Test
ports.note: Front-panel monitor tap, 20dB below primary QAM output.

ports.name: AC In
ports.note: IEC C14 inlet. Unit ships fixed for 115VAC only (2.0A, Slo-Blo 3.0A/250V fuse) - rear panel explicitly warns it is NOT auto-switching and must be factory-refitted by Blonder Tongue for 220VAC.
